scope: Technical v1.0 release requirements. This inventory records remaining work; it is not acceptance evidence or release authorization.

gates.title: Stable language
required: Versioned language specification, support matrix, compatibility and migration rules, and conformance tests covering the stable semantics.
remaining: The typed edition is experimental; stable semantics and their complete conformance suite are not implemented.

gates.title: Safe general-purpose core
required: General heap allocation, growing containers, borrowing, destruction and concurrency safety contracts, with positive, negative, boundary and regression tests.
No known blocking miscompilation, soundness, data-corruption or security defect in the supported scope; applicable fuzzing and dynamic checks.
remaining: Ownership supports bounded records, fixed arrays, local references to whole values and call-only borrowing of distinct record fields; general containers, heap/destructor semantics and references stored in values or returned from functions are incomplete.

gates.title: Production native compilation
required: Native build, execution, debugging and release profiles on Linux x86_64, Linux ARM64, Windows x86_64, macOS x86_64 and macOS ARM64.
General hosted execution without demonstration fuel limits, verified optimization and realistic multi-module clean/incremental builds.
remaining: Native project compilation supports Linux x86_64 and ARM64 using LLVM 19.1.7 at O0/O2 with optional hosted execution; repository CI verifies the supported hosts. Windows/macOS native targets, source debugging, larger compiler/storage limits and full-scale build acceptance remain incomplete.

gates.title: Complete runtime
required: Typed-native binary files and streams, processes, threads, asynchronous I/O, cancellation and resource cleanup with failure-path contracts.
A concurrent HTTPS/database service with load, timeout, cancellation, restart, connection exhaustion and graceful-shutdown acceptance results.
remaining: Legacy file/process/network helpers and sequential lazy tasks do not provide the required typed-native runtime.

gates.title: Packages and builds
required: A consistent typed project/workspace build, run, test and package workflow with editions, targets and profiles.
Multi-version dependencies, registry publishing, lockfiles, offline/frozen/vendor builds, integrity and supply-chain verification.
remaining: Manifest-selected project/workspace commands, local dependency sessions, typed input locks, source bundles, native object reuse and relocatable builds for a fixed toolchain/layout are experimental; vendoring, registry/version resolution and broader native artifact qualification remain incomplete.

gates.title: Development tools
required: LSP, formatter, test runner, debugger integration, versioned documentation and profiling support the same ordinary project workflow.
remaining: Typed project/workspace API generation uses checked sources, manifests and locks; live cross-file diagnostics and formatting use unsaved editor buffers. Scoped name completion reads unsaved buffers; member/qualified-path completion, type/member navigation, aggregate debugging, versioned documentation delivery and profiling remain incomplete.

gates.title: Native interoperation and migration
required: The same Oxid native library integrates with C, Rust and Python, including error, callback, cross-thread and resource-release tests.
Migration tooling explicitly reports unsupported features, and Python native extensions support standard packaging.
remaining: Existing subprocess adapters do not implement the required native library ABI and Python extension workflow.

gates.title: Compiler self-hosting
required: A published Oxid seed rebuilds the specified compiler and standard library without Rust/Cargo or hidden Rust frontend fallback.
Reproducible same-target C1/C2/C3 compiler rebuilds demonstrate a C2/C3 fixed point and compile other supported programs.
remaining: Rust still owns parser, semantic, ownership, OIR and backend authority; component demos and AST serialization round-trips are not compiler rebuilds.

gates.title: Applications and performance
required: Six ordinary applications cover native CLI/data processing, HTTPS/database service, background work, native interoperation, CPU training and the compiler/toolchain.
Native CPU tensor, autograd, optimizer, data loading and checkpoint resume pass numerical, gradient, convergence and recovery acceptance tests.
Fixed workload comparisons preserve equivalent outputs and safety semantics, with raw measurements, environment, uncertainty and upgrade/recovery results.
remaining: Native f64 matrix/autograd training includes SGD, Adam, AdamW, deterministic paired batches and checkpoint recovery verification; general tensor layouts, streaming data loading, larger models and complete performance acceptance remain incomplete.
The six complete applications and comparative performance acceptance corpus remain incomplete.

gates.title: Release delivery and upgrades
required: Versioned artifacts have source provenance, checksums, signatures, supported platforms and external dependency declarations.
Installation, update, rollback and offline deployment are exercised; two release candidates pass technical acceptance, with affected checks rerun after core changes.
remaining: The five-host archive workflow includes source-signature verification and the Unix installer supports offline archives and failure preservation; actual signed release artifacts, five-platform native delivery, complete cross-version upgrades/rollback and two qualified v1 release candidates remain unverified.
